steps: sin^3A − cos^3A = (sinA − cosA)(sin^2A + sinA cosA + cos^2A)
check_code:
import sympy as sp
A=sp.symbols('A')
e=(sp.sin(A)**3-sp.cos(A)**3)/(sp.sin(A)-sp.cos(A))
opts={'A':3*sp.cos(A)-1,'B':1-3*sp.sin(A),'C':sp.sin(A)+sp.cos(A),'D':1+sp.sin(A)*sp.cos(A)}
x=sp.Rational(1,3)
assert sp.simplify(e-opts['D'])==0
for k in 'ABC': assert abs(float((e-opts[k]).subs(A,x)))>1e-6

method: Work-rate equation in total time T (SymPy)
check_code:

T=sp.symbols('T')
R=sp.Rational
eq=10*(R(1,50)+R(1,100))+(T-25)*(R(1,25)+R(1,100))+15*R(1,25)-1
v=sp.solve(eq,T)[0]
assert v-15>=10
opts={'A':27,'B':42,'C':30,'D':33}
assert v==opts['A']
for k in 'BCD': assert v!=opts[k]
